integrity: Self-contained proof and standard-library executable checker; no claim of independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Normal-form length is not arbitrary semigroup word length.
The inverse-length probability law assumes primitive adjacency and Perron root greater than one; exact rational enumerators apply to all finite directed multigraphs.
Finite examples corroborate but do not replace proof; historical equivalence is a residual risk.
title: Square-zero growth and the inverse-length persistence law for graph inverse semigroups
